_note: Official X accounts the daily engagement run checks for posts to reply to (scripts/social-x-posts.mjs). Keep it to 28 or fewer: X allows about 30 feed reads per 15 minutes and the run does not wait for more. Every handle should also be in scripts/x-sources.json, which says whether the account is a MENA body (every robotics post counts) or a supplier (the post must also name a MENA place). Governments, regulators, operators, events and companies only: no news outlets, influencers or private individuals.
